title: @dsar/node-sdk
description: Typed Node SDK for DSAR backend APIs.
usage: Configuration: baseUrl (or DSAR_API_URL) required; token (or DSAR_API_TOKEN) optional; timeoutMs (default 10000), retryMaxAttempts (default 2), fetch, debug.
Headers: Authorization and x-idempotency-key when available. Per-request overrides via method options.
Result helpers: result.unwrap(), result.expect(message?), result.orElse(fallback). Non-success responses reject with DsarSdkError and retriable metadata.
